book_meta.work: short stories by Guy de Maupassant and Anton Chekhov
book_meta.author: Maupassant (d. 1893) and Chekhov (d. 1904)
book_meta.status: public domain — retold from the plots, no translation used

sentences.ar: المفتش أوتشوميلوف ماشي بالساحة، وعليه معطفه الجديد، وبإيده رزمة.
sentences.en: Inspector Ochumelov walks across the square, in his new overcoat, a bundle in his hand.

sentences.ar: ووراه شرطي، وبإيده سلة عنب مصادر.
sentences.en: And behind him a policeman, with a basket of confiscated gooseberries.

sentences.ar: والساحة فاضية، والدكاكين مفتوحة على الفراغ، زي أفواه جوعانة.
sentences.en: And the square empty, the shops open on nothing, like hungry mouths.
And suddenly, a voice: you bite?
Hold him!
No biting!
And a dog's yelp.

sentences.ar: ومن مخزن الخشب، طلع كلب على تلات إجرين، وبيركض، ووراه رجل بقميص، وبيصرخ.
sentences.en: And out of the timber yard came a dog on three legs, running, and after it a man in a shirt, shouting.

sentences.ar: ومسك الكلب من إجره الخلفية، وصار الناس يتجمعوا.
sentences.en: And caught the dog by a hind leg, and people began to gather.
The inspector said: what is going on here?

sentences.ar: قال الرجل، خريوكين، صايغ: يا سعادتك، أنا ماشي، ما بعمل شي.
sentences.en: The man, Khryukin, a goldsmith, said: Your Honour, I was walking, doing nothing.
And this dog bit my finger.
And raised his finger, with blood on it.
And I work with my hands!
Let its owner pay!
The inspector said: right!
Dogs cannot run loose like this!
Whose dog is it?

sentences.ar: بنكتب محضر، وبنغرم صاحبه، وبنقتل الكلب.
sentences.en: We write a report, fine the owner, and put the dog down.

sentences.ar: وقال حدا من الجمهور: يمكن كلب الجنرال جيغالوف.
sentences.en: And someone in the crowd said: perhaps it is General Zhigalov's dog.
And the inspector stopped.
He said: the general's?
Hmm.
Take my coat off me, it is hot today.

sentences.ar: وتطلع بالكلب، وقال: بس شو هالكلب الزغير!
sentences.en: And looked at the dog, and said: but what a small dog!
How does it reach your finger?

sentences.ar: يا خريوكين، إنت جرحت إصبعك بمسمار، وبدك تكذب على كلب!
sentences.en: Khryukin, you cut your finger on a nail, and want to blame a dog!

sentences.ar: وقال الشرطي: لا، الجنرال كلابه صيد.
sentences.en: And the policeman said: no, the general's dogs are hunting dogs.
This is not his.
The inspector said: sure?
The policeman said: sure.
The inspector said: I know it too.
The general's dogs are valuable.
And this?
A street dog!
We put it down!
And Khryukin, poor man, you are in the right.

sentences.ar: وقال حدا تاني: لا، هاد كلب الجنرال.
sentences.en: And someone else said: no, it is the general's dog.
I saw it in his garden.
The inspector said: put my coat on me.
There is a chill.
And looked at the dog, and said: a fine dog!

sentences.ar: يا خريوكين، إنت اللي عبثت فيه بإصبعك!
sentences.en: Khryukin, you are the one who poked it with your finger!

sentences.ar: وطلع من الحديقة طباخ الجنرال، وسألوه: هاد كلبكم؟
sentences.en: And the general's cook came out of the garden, and they asked him: is this your dog?
The cook said: no.
We have none like it.
The inspector said: you see?
A street dog!
Kill it!

sentences.ar: قال الطباخ: بس هاد كلب أخو الجنرال، اللي وصل مبارح.
sentences.en: The cook said: but it is the general's brother's dog, who arrived yesterday.
The inspector said: his brother!
He has arrived?
Good God!
And I did not know!
And this is his dog?
And laughed, his face gone all kindness.
And said to the dog: sweet thing!
Little one!
He bit you, Khryukin?
Ha ha ha!
The poor thing is trembling!

sentences.ar: وأخد الطباخ الكلب، والناس ضحكوا على خريوكين.
sentences.en: And the cook took the dog, and the people laughed at Khryukin.
And the inspector said to Khryukin: I will deal with you!
And went on his way across the square.
